title: Pan-Seared Juicy Eastern Chicken with Morbier and Mansaf Grains
description: A flavorful and nutritious meal that combines the juiciness of chicken with the savory flavors of Eastern spices, served with a side of herb-infused grains.
instructions: 2. Season chicken breast with eastern spices, salt, and black pepper.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken breast for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Transfer the chicken breast to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
5. While the chicken is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the crumbled Morbier cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
6. To serve, place a cooked chicken breast on a plate and top with a spoonful of the Morbier cheese sauce. Serve with a side of Mansaf grain and garnish with chopped parsley and a lemon wedge.
7. Cook the Mansaf grain according to package instructions. Typically, it is cooked with chicken or beef broth and herbs.
8. To prepare the eastern spices, combine ground cumin, coriander, and paprika in a small bowl. Mix well to combine.
9. To make the Morbier cheese sauce, stir the crumbled cheese over low heat until melted and smooth. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
10. To garnish, sprinkle chopped parsley over the top of the chicken breast and serve with a lemon wedge on the side.
